name: Water
desc: Standard water. Allows for Sparkling Ripples to appear

name: Ocean Water
desc: Sparkling sea water. Ripples cannot appear here

name: Muddy Water
desc:
Muddy water. Ripples cannot appear here

name: Hot Spring Water
desc: Hot water. Pokémon may enter pools of this to relax. Ripples cannot appear here

name: Lava
desc:
Lava. Does not hydrate the area. Damages Ditto if touched
Use Water Gun on the Lava to turn it into Black Rock
